english.title: Removal of / interference with immobilisation notice
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without the authority of an authorised person

(A)_[removed]_
(B)_[interfered with]_

an immobilisation notice attached to a vehicle namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), in accordance with the Vehicle Excise Duty (Immobilisation, Removal and Disposal of Vehicles) Regulations 1997
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 7(1) and (2) of the Vehicle Excise Duty (Immobilisation, Removal and Disposal of Vehicles) Regulations 1997.
